kibitzers: There were more calls for food, too, and the crap game in the side room annexed more players and more kibitzers.
kibble's: Lydgate also, finding that his sum of eight hundred pounds had been considerably reduced since he had come to Middlemarch, restrained his inclination for some plate of an old pattern which was shown to him when he went into Kibble’s establishment at Brassing to buy forks and spoons.
